bodyHtml:
What This Is

Power rails routed on the backside of the wafer (below active devices) to reduce IR drop and free frontside routing tracks; enables density and power efficiency at 2nm and below; Intel/TSMC active development..

Pilot deployments and early-stage commercial testing underway. Technology is proven at small scale. Our research database tracks 19 independent sources on this technology.

Thermo Fisher advanced logic white paper identifies backside metal layers for power distribution as a new challenge for failure analysis labs; adoption of new FA processes required at advanced nodes.

Status

Attribute Value
Development Stage Pilot / Limited Deployment
Confidence Level Speculative
Confidence Score +0.18
Estimated Deployment 2024–2028
Horizon Near-Term (Now–2026)
Independent Sources Tracked 19

Prerequisites

This technology depends on or is closely linked to:

  • Advanced Logic Failure Analysis Workflows
  • Nanosheet Transistor (GAA architecture)

Investment Exposure

No direct listed-stock exposure identified yet in our research database.
